R516.why: 1.5 kΩ drop-node leg, at K501's drop contact (pin 2), next to its partner R518, so both legs meet the centre tap with equal length (DEC-017, OA §5.3).

R517.why: 49.9 Ω end-node leg at K501's end contact (pin 4), beside R519 (DEC-017, OA §6.4.1).

R518.why: 1.5 kΩ drop-node leg on the N side, mirror of R516 (DEC-017).

R519.why: 49.9 Ω end-node leg on the N side, mirror of R517 (DEC-017).

R520.why: Centre-tap 100 kΩ bleed; DC only, may move 2 mm (DEC-017).

C514.why: Centre-tap 100 nF to ground, between the four legs (DEC-017).

D501.why: ESD on T1S_P at J903's pins, in line on the pair at the connector (Microchip AN1718 rev. D §2.0).

D502.why: ESD on T1S_N, beside D501 (Microchip AN1718 rev. D §2.0).

C511.why: DC-block on T1S_P at the choke's line side (DEC-012 rev. B: DC block on the connector side of the choke); pad within 3 mm of FL501 (intent).

C512.why: DC-block on T1S_N, mirror of C511 (DEC-012 rev. B).

FL501.why: Common-mode choke between the DC block and the PHY; nothing on any layer under it (Microchip AN1718 rev. D §2.0); PHY line pins within 12 mm (intent).

U501.why: LAN8670 PHY north of both busbars, between the T1S zone and the MCU: line stub from the trunk short, RMII to U401 within 25 mm (plan v1).

Y501.why: 50 MHz oscillator south-east of U501, its output to R503 within 5 mm; 35 mm from the nearest switch node (plan: quiet zone).

R503.why: REFCLK series resistor beside Y501, 4.6 mm from U501's pin 27 (as placed). A swap into U501's corner was tried and routed worse; reachability on pin 27 reads PASSABLE (0.3 mm margin), so the pose stays.

R504.why: RMII REF_CLK series resistor at the oscillator, its far side toward U401's U6 ball.

R501.why: RBIAS 12.4 kΩ directly under U501's RBIAS pin 26, as placed.

Q501.why: Relay coil driver (set), within 8 mm of K501 (intent); slow pulse drive, may move 2 mm.

Q502.why: Relay coil driver (reset), within 8 mm of K501 (intent).
